findings.note: RotoWire (Oct 5) says Metchie's five targets in Week 4 came while Jalen Coker was out with a quad injury and that he would go back to a rotational role once Coker was cleared. This week's status for Coker and Legette was not confirmed.

His game log shows 2, 3 and 2 catches in his last three games (Weeks 3, 4 and 6), 0 catches in Week 2, and inactive in Week 1. It also notes he has never had more than 29 catches in a season and was listed as the No. 5 WR and return man in September.

ESPN shows him active for Sunday's home game against Tampa Bay with 7 catches on 13 targets this season. In Week 6 at Philadelphia he had only 3 targets (2 catches), and ESPN's season projection is about 24 catches.
